name: Startup Capital
description:
TechBBQ will host 🚀Startup Capital 🚀- our first online matchmaking event that connects pre-seed, seed-stage, and series-A startups with international investors through virtual facilitated matchmaking activities. The event is going to happen on the 18th of June 2020.

Startup Capital will link together 50 Global VC Fund and 50 Nordic startups in a 3-hour session! 

Our goal is to facilitate and curate efficient 💬conversations between startups and investors to increase investment flow, enhance Impact, align capital, reduce perceived investment risks and encourage continuous collaboration between investors and entrepreneurs – for the purpose of exchanging 💸financing and 📚knowledge flows.

This project is done in partnership with byFounders, Silicon Valley Bank, Danish Business Angels, Danske Bank, and Vækstfonden.

✏️Applications are closed for this event, but sign up to our newsletter to be the first one to know about the next edition, in September: https://fal.cn/techbbq0570
